notes: Curated build holds records whose stored title/abstract/keywords/MeSH do not establish the molecule (excluded_noise, reversible). MeSH / substance headings count only when the WHOLE heading equals a name of the molecule.

Trials feed + molecule trial counts. A trial is kept when the molecule is an intervention / other name / arm (exposure), is in the titles, conditions or keywords (subject), or is an outcome MEASURE (measured_outcome: genuine biomarker studies). A name only in outcome descriptions, the summary or eligibility text is a background mention and is held (add background" to publish_roles to publish those too)."
